title: The Listening Hymn
author: Isandro Ravensworth
blurb: Ivo Kavanagh, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
